title: ARSIA Audit Chain Tombstone
description: Entry that replaces a permanently deleted chained audit record at its chain position, written by the operator-controlled maintenance path (ARSIA-State.md §7.2, §7.3). It carries only the chain context, the position, the deleted record's chain value and the previous chain value used to compute it — no field of the deleted record. It persists for as long as its chain exists. Returned only by audit queries with chain_id (ARSIA-State.md §7.4).

allOf.description: Identifier of the chain. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.2.

chain_seq.description: Position of the deleted record in its chain. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.2.

chain_format.description: Chain-format version of the chain. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.2.

allOf.description: The deleted record's chain value. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.2.

previous_chain_value.description: The chain value P used to compute the deleted record's chain value: the chain value of the preceding entry, or null at position 1. Per ARSIA-State.md §7.2.
